## Checklist

See `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

- [ ] Failing tests were committed before the implementation.
- [ ] The checks in "Setup and checks" pass on my machine, or I say below which I ran.
- [ ] Under about 1,500 changed lines, not counting generated maps and fixtures.
- [ ] Documents that travel with code are included (module spec, ADR, `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`, `source`/`assumed` fields, `req` markers).
- [ ] No new dependency outside section 5 of the design document, or an ADR for it.
- [ ] Nothing that identifies a real facility, and no text copied from a facility's design document or from a standard.
- [ ] No authorship or co-author trailer naming an AI tool, in commits or in files.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under "Unreleased", if users will notice the change.
